after.reason: Exact retailer returns403. Queue modelMNESMAXW-Short BP identifies a mechanical backplate, so inverter electrical labels are inapplicable; current exact retailer binding remains blocked. No inverter ratings are transferred.

appliedReviewHistory.reason: Independent full-source inspection corrected the stated missing-field disposition, technical scope, prior verified coverage, or access limitation; the original note is retained exactly in before.

noteDispositionCorrections.reason: Apply the latest independently reviewed disposition in phase order: primary, supplemental, additional. Earlier notes and exact before/after corrections remain preserved in sourceReviews and researchNotes.

independentSourceFindings.scope: Independent primary source findings; supplemental review and final normalization decisions are recorded in their complete ledgers.
independentSourceFindings.summary: Independent review excludes battery ratings copied onto an empty rack, unbound selected variants, conflicting hardware generations, unreadable source tables, and conflicting temperature or current limits. It corrects actual supporting datasheet URLs, regional output modes, whole-cable versus connector ratings, operating versus MPPT voltage, and revision-specific inverter output. Source footnotes retain cell test conditions, timed peaks, thermal derating and enclosure configuration. Recommended PV oversizing remains distinct from a hard input maximum, and connector contact material remains distinct from cable conductor material.

findings: ECO-WORTHY empty R6 rack cannot inherit SG48100P battery data.
Pytes actual operating manual differs from an originally cited UL9540A bracket test report.
EnergyTrek US and UK source temperature, dimension and peak differences stay explicit.
MB31 Version A nominal capacity/energy conditions remain per fresh cell; retail pack counts do not multiply the source ratings.
Phoenix 120 V regional applicability retained.
SimpliPHI exact SPHI manual differs from the originally proposed PHI-HB sheet.
GoodWe source footnotes retain battery/PV voltage limits and no-battery feed-in restrictions.
PowMr voltage and Rich Solar current disagreements remain held; EcoFlow inverter-unit and port scope stay explicit.
Mechanical glands/clamps and cable compatibility are not electrical connector ratings.
Contact metal is not supplied-cable conductor material; per-foot sale is not a fixed cable length.
PECRON 800 W at 40 V/20 A is an input operating condition, not independent insulation voltage and ampacity.
Surge protector surge current is not breaker interrupt capacity; occupied spaces are not pole count.
MNPV output currents retain exact model and operating configuration; conflicting voltage mappings remain held.
Type 1 enclosure classification does not become an IEC IP rating.
Selected WattCycle and Vatrer variants require exact binding despite a readable parent table.
MultiPlus-II 48/5000 exact linked sheet supports 9000 W peak; distinct legacy and current Phoenix/Compact power values remain held.
Solis SG11.4KHB-HV 18240 W is explicitly recommended PV sizing, not a maximum utilized input.
Unreadable raster table cells and obscured conditions are not reconstructed.
Orange connector listing is male-plus-cap; absent female/contact parts are not invented.
SP2.2LS uses its dedicated low-voltage manual, not the generic high-voltage pump manual.
ECO 5 kW source distinguishes single-unit 120 V output from parallel split-phase and PV operating range from MPPT range.
Enphase source revision, regional model, output modes and maximum-versus-nominal voltage remain explicit; Sol-Ark generation conflicts stay held.
